title: metadax.negative-space/0.3
_why: X11/B14 — a raw unfollowed share is meaningless because a seed counts unfollowed even if no one ever saw it. This record forces the exposure split so only choice-bearing figures are reported.

declined._why: declined counts ONLY if the seed was offered.

unseen._why: never surfaced to anyone — not a learner choice.

exposure_normalised_decline_rate._def: declined / (followed + declined) — the only choice-bearing figure.
